Minimo: Voice Translate & Note
Your voice is deeply personal. Minimo ensures it stays that way. 

Minimo is a powerful voice transcription and translation tool powered entirely by advanced on-device AI. Whether you're capturing fleeting thoughts, dictating a journal entry, translating conversations on the go, or organizing meeting notes, Minimo works completely offline—meaning your data never leaves your iPhone.

WHY MINIMO?
Cloud-based AI apps send your sensitive audio to external servers. Minimo brings the AI directly to you. Enjoy blazing-fast, highly accurate transcription and translation from anywhere in the world, without needing Wi-Fi or cellular data. Zero tracking, zero uploads, zero compromises.

CORE FEATURES:

--Instant Offline Transcription
Speak naturally and watch your words turn into text instantly. Minimo's offline speech recognition is fast, accurate, and incredibly secure.

--On-the-Go Translation
Break down language barriers with seamless voice translation. Perfect for traveling, learning a new language, or holding multi-lingual conversations without an internet connection.

--Secure Face ID Vault
Keep your most private thoughts strictly confidential. Lock sensitive transcripts inside an encrypted vault that only your Face ID can open.

--Smart Note Organization
Keep your ideas structured. Assign custom tags to categorize your transcripts, making it effortless to find exactly what you're looking for later.

--Apple Reminders Integration
Turn speech into action. Minimo can automatically extract action items from your transcripts and add them directly to your Apple Reminders app.

--One-Tap Widget
Never lose a thought again. Use the Minimo Home Screen widget to start recording securely with a single tap.

STRICTLY PRIVATE BY DESIGN
We believe your data is yours alone. 
• No audio files are ever uploaded.
• No cloud processing.
• No account creation required. 
Everything happens directly on the silicon of your iPhone.

MINIMO PRO
Unlock the full potential of your on-device AI with a Minimo Pro subscription or a one-time Lifetime Unlock, which grants unlimited access to all premium features, offline translation models, and advanced organization tools.
